# Canva Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Review window: 16 October to 15 November 2026. The brief does not state the meeting's purpose, so this briefing covers general company developments. The one-page format for meeting briefings takes precedence over the requested 1,200-word minimum.*

## Summary

Canva announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 roles, about 22% of staff, on 3 November (US time) and 4 November (Sydney time) 2026 ([Varley, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life)). The figure covers redundancies, changed roles and relocation requests, not confirmed exits ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). Product, Growth and Platform are merging into one product organisation ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Restructure and Organisation

| Date (2026) | Development | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 3–4 Nov | CEO Melanie Perkins called it the "hardest moment" in the company's 13-year history; the memo says small changes "won't be enough" | [Varley, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life); [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| 3–4 Nov | Management layers simplified; more teams concentrated in Sydney | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| 10–11 Nov | Company-wide meeting on 10 November; reorganised teams meet from 11 November | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| From Jan 2027 | Most hybrid staff expected in office two to three days a week | [employerbranding.news (n.d.)](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle) |

### Severance and Terms (Verified Against Reporting)

- Departing staff receive at least six months' base pay, regardless of location ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)).
- Benefits include 12 months of healthcare where Canva already provides it, career coaching, a year of LinkedIn Premium, retained MacBooks, removal of the one-year vesting cliff, and optional US$10,000 grants ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).
- Quartz treats the six-month floor, MacBook retention and grants as outliers against a 16-week sector baseline ([Quartz, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)).

### Launches, Hires and Deals

- **Launches:** Canva released Craft, its in-house image model, in October 2026 ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). The exact date is unverified and should be confirmed.
- **Hiring:** No dated hiring data falls in the window. Reporting says Canva is concentrating product teams in Sydney, which suggests fewer remote openings outside Australia ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). This is an inference, not a confirmed policy.
- **Deals:** No acquisition in the window appears in the sources. Tracxn lists seven 2026 acquisitions, the latest being Ortto in April, which is outside the window ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY)).

### Items Outside the 30-Day Window (Context Only)

| Item | Date | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Growth forecast cut from 30% to 20%, citing AI feature costs | August 2026 | [employerbranding.news (n.d.)](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle) |
| Ortto acquisition | April 2026 | [Canva Newsroom (2026)](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/simtheory-ortto-join-canva) |
| Ten of 12 technical writers cut | 2025 | [employerbranding.news (n.d.)](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle) |

## Assessment

**Verified:** The restructure is confirmed, the 1,271 figure is confirmed as "affected roles," and the severance floor is reported consistently across sources.

**Inference:** The cuts appear driven by coordination costs and AI compute costs rather than automation replacing workers. The August forecast cut was linked to AI feature costs ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)). Canva's memo blames structure, not automation ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). CTO Magazine cautions against equating the layoffs with AI substitution ([Gomes, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand)). I judge the structural explanation credible, but it cannot be fully verified until the split between redundancies, role changes and relocations is disclosed.

## Data Gaps and Discrepancies

- **Headcount:** Canva has not said how many will leave ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). No country split has been published ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).
- **Valuation:** Reporting cites US$34.9 billion after a 17% cut ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)), while Forbes Australia implies about US$30.4 billion ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)). The dates and methods differ.
- **Revenue:** A US$4 billion ARR figure (February) and an annualised ~US$3.69 billion figure (October) use different measures ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)).
- **"First mass layoff":** One HR source calls this Canva's first mass layoff ([amazingworkplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)), which conflicts with earlier cuts reported elsewhere ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)).
- **Post-10 November outcomes:** No reporting on the company-wide meeting is available.

**Macro context:** US employers announced 43,994 job cuts in October 2026, down 71% year on year ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). Canva's cuts are therefore unusually large relative to the broader market.

## Three Open Questions

1. **Workforce split:** How do the 1,271 affected roles break down into redundancies, role changes and relocations, and by country?
2. **Operating model:** After the 10 November meeting, what are the scope and reporting lines of the merged product organisation, and will remaining roles outside Sydney remain remote-eligible?
3. **Financial outlook:** Is the 20% growth forecast still current, and what progress has been made on cutting AI cost per task?

This was founder Melanie Perkins’ letter to those affected: https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update/
